sections.title: Contributors to population change in Barrow-in-Furness
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component, %

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Barrow-in-Furness, between 2025 and 2028:

  • More deaths than births meant that the population decreased by 2,476 people (−3.7%). In total, there were 5,989 births and 8,464 deaths in Barrow-in-Furness between 2025 and 2028.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in England) increased the population by 137 (0.2%). There were 18,916 people entering the area and 18,779 people leaving the area between 2025 and .
  • Net cross-border migration (between UK nations) led to a fall in the local population in Barrow-in-Furness of 38 people (−0.1%), as a result of 964 people entering the area and 1,002 people leaving the area between 2025 and 2028.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Barrow-in-Furness' population of 1,150 (1.7%).as a result of 1,974 people entering the area and 824 people leaving the area between 2025 and 2028.
